systems.name: 2.1 New Enemy Types
systems.notes: Add 2–3 new enemy varieties with distinct movement patterns: a bouncer (diagonal bounce off walls), a homing drone, and a stationary turret that shoots.
tasks: Design sprite data for new enemies
Implement basic homing (adjust X/Y velocity toward player)
Turret that spawns a projectile on a timer

systems.name: 2.2 Enemy Spawning & Wave System
systems.notes: Instead of 3 hardcoded enemies, spawn waves that increase in number and speed as the player collects more fuel/pickups. Add a brief delay between enemy spawns.
tasks: Enemy spawn timer and wave counter
Dynamic difficulty: more enemies, faster movement over time
Respawn enemies after they are destroyed (if combat is added)

systems.name: 2.3 Combat & Enemy Destruction
systems.notes: Currently enemies only kill on contact. Add a way to shoot them (e.g., press fire to shoot a short‑range laser). Destroyed enemies drop bonus fuel or score.
tasks: Add fire button (bit 0 of input?) and projectile logic
Enemy health (1 hit for basic, 2 for bosses)
